page.overview:
What is Rip It Up?

Rip It Up is a song by Robert Blackwell and John Marascalo from 1956 that was originally a hit for Little Richard and later a success for Bill Haley and His Comets. It was also recorded by Elvis Presley. A version by The Beatles ( in the medley: Rip It Up/Shake, Rattle and Roll/Blue Suede Shoes), dating from the Let it Be sessions, is found on Anthology 3.
